title: A common finite coefficient Hom stage for a finite family
statement: Use [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] and [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let ell be prime, E a finite coefficient field, J a finite type, Y_j qcqs schemes, P_j,Q_j internal E_(Y_j)-modules and P_j globally finitely presented. For every family a_j:P_j→Res_EOmega(Omega tensor_E Q_j), there is one finite F≥E and maps b_j:P_j→Res_EF(F tensor_E Q_j) whose composites with the specified mixedScalarMap coefficient inclusions equal a_j. The Q_j are arbitrary.

proof.text: Apply the single coefficient Hom stage theorem on each Y_j.
Filteredness gives an upper object for the finite set consisting of E and all the resulting fields. Including E makes the argument work when J is empty.

Compose each descended map with its mixedScalarMap transition to the common field. The mixedScalarMap composition theorem and composition of the coefficient inclusions prove the required factorization equation.

theorem condensed_coefficient_family_hom_stage
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (J : Type u) [Finite J] (Y : J → Scheme.{u})
    [∀ j, CompactSpace (Y j)] [∀ j, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Y j)]
    (P Q : ∀ j, Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Y j)) Ab.{u + 1})
      (padicSubfieldRingObj (Y j) ℓ E))
    (hP : ∀ j, Mod.IsFinitelyPresented (padicSubfieldRingObj (Y j) ℓ E) (P j))
    (a : ∀ j, P j ⟶ (Mod.comap (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ E)).obj
      ((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ E)).obj (Q j))) :
    ∃ (F : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (hEF : E ≤ F)
      (b : ∀ j, P j ⟶ (Mod.comap (padicSubfieldRingObjMap (Y j) ℓ hEF)).obj
        ((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjMap (Y j) ℓ hEF)).obj (Q j))),
      ∀ j, b j ≫ Mod.mixedScalarMap
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap (Y j) ℓ hEF) (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ E)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap (Y j) ℓ hEF) (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ E)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ F)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap_comp_toPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ hEF)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap_comp_toPadicAlgCl (Y j) ℓ hEF) (Q j) = a j
